items.prompt:
Rhetorical synthesis questions give you:
A) bulleted notes and a goal
B) a poem
C) a map
items.answer: A) bulleted notes and a goal

solution.answer: A) bulleted notes and a goal

items.prompt:
You should choose the sentence that best meets the:
A) stated goal
B) longest option
C) first option

steps: Match the task. Key is A.

items.prompt:
The sentence must use facts drawn from the:
A) notes
B) your memory
C) the answer letters

steps: No outside info. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Notes: Maple and oak are both hardwoods; maple leaves turn red; oak leaves turn brown.

Goal: emphasize a DIFFERENCE. Best sentence:
A) In fall, maple leaves turn red, while oak leaves turn brown
B) Both maple and oak are hardwoods
C) Trees are interesting
items.answer: A) In fall, maple leaves turn red, while oak leaves turn brown

solution.answer: A) In fall, maple leaves turn red, while oak leaves turn brown

items.prompt:
Same notes. Goal: emphasize a SIMILARITY. Best sentence:
A) Both maple and oak are hardwood trees
B) Maple leaves turn red
C) Oak leaves turn brown
items.answer: A) Both maple and oak are hardwood trees

solution.answer: A) Both maple and oak are hardwood trees

items.prompt:
A sentence that is accurate but does not meet the stated goal is:
A) still wrong for the question
B) the best answer
C) always correct
items.answer: A) still wrong for the question

steps: Must meet the goal. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) still wrong for the question

items.prompt:
Notes: The comet appears every 76 years; it last appeared in 1986; it will next appear in 2061.

Goal: help a reader calculate the cycle. Best sentence:
A) Appearing in 1986 and again in 2061, the comet returns on a 76-year cycle
B) The comet is bright
C) Comets are icy bodies
items.answer: A) Appearing in 1986 and again in 2061, the comet returns on a 76-year cycle

steps: Links dates to the cycle. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) Appearing in 1986 and again in 2061, the comet returns on a 76-year cycle

items.prompt:
Notes: Study A found the drug cut symptoms 30%; Study B found it cut them 32%.

Goal: emphasize that the two studies AGREE. Best sentence:
A) Both studies found the drug cut symptoms by roughly a third
B) Study A found a 30% cut
C) The drug is a pill
items.answer: A) Both studies found the drug cut symptoms by roughly a third

solution.answer: A) Both studies found the drug cut symptoms by roughly a third
